b.) Environmental Statement Comments
The statement contains no mention of
any consideration given to historical
values that might be affected by the
proposal nor is there any indication
of consultation with the State
Liaison Officer for Historic Preser-
vation. The final environmental im-
pact statement should point out
wheather any historic sites will be
affected along with giving evidence
of consultations with the State
Liaison Officer for Historic Preser-
vation, who is the Director, Depart-
ment of Conservation, 102 State
Office Building, 400 South Spring
Street, Springfield, Illinois 62706.
b.)Concur - The Statement has been updated to include evidence of consultation (See Page I-22 and page III-8.)
c.)Because at least one stream (Thorn Creek) will be crossed, the final environmental impact statement should contain a discussion of the impact of the project on the stream and life systems associated with the creek and measures to be taken to reduce damage. We also recommend that a thorough study be made to determine the appropriate sizes for the water structures at stream crossings in this project.
